annotations.title: Web read batch: up to 5 URLs to clean Markdown in one call

description: Use when an agent has several URLs (search results, citations) and needs them all as Markdown at once. Input: urls (1-5 public URLs separated by spaces), optional max_chars per URL (500-20000), flags=1. Output: JSON results[] in input order, each status ok (markdown, title, finalUrl) or error (code, message). Charged once if at least one page is read. Behavior: duplicates dropped; up to 3 URLs fetched in parallel, each with a 15 s timeout, at most 3 redirects and a 3 MB page cap. A URL that fails (timeout, HTTP error, too many redirects, noai opt-out) comes back as status error with code and httpStatus while the others still return; login walls return whatever the public page shows. Markdown is cut at max_chars per URL (truncated flag). Private or malformed URLs: 400 before payment; all URLs failing: 502, not charged. Use instead: web_read for one URL (up to 60,000 chars); web_read_brief for an English brief of one page; convert_to_markdown for PDF, DOCX or HWP documents; web_search_read for a query without URLs yet. Example: ?urls=https://example.com/ https://example.org/ Price: $0.008 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
